task: In the Hugging Face documentation, find the tutorial on loading adapters with PEFT, tell me how to load in 8bit or 4bit.
answer: To load a PEFT adapter in 8bit or 4bit, you quantize the base model with the bitsandbytes integration via transformers' BitsAndBytesConfig and pass it as quantization_config when loading the model, then attach the adapter with PEFT. 4-bit: from transformers import BitsAndBytesConfig; config = BitsAndBytesConfig(load_in_4bit=True, bnb_4bit_quant_type='nf4', bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=True, bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=torch.bfloat16); model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_id, quantization_config=config, device_map='auto'); model = prepare_model_for_kbit_training(model); then apply LoraConfig/get_peft_model or load the adapter with PeftModel.from_pretrained(model, adapter_id). 8-bit: set load_in_8bit=True in BitsAndBytesConfig instead and pass it the same way as quantization_config. Source: Hugging Face PEFT docs, Developer guides > Quantization (https://huggingface.co/docs/peft/developer_guides/quantization).
